prompt: Who was the Vice Admiral in charge of the Carrier Division the Japanese carrier Hiyō was in when she was sunk?
answer: Vice Admiral **Jisaburō Ozawa** was in overall command of the Japanese First Mobile Fleet, which included Hiyō’s **Carrier Division 2**, when Hiyō was sunk during the Battle of the Philippine Sea on June 20, 1944. The division’s immediate commander was Rear Admiral **Takatsugu Jōjima**.
